trailers.overview: Six college students meet at the final interview of a global IT company. Growing closer as they prepare for the group discussion, they dare to dream that all six might make it — until the day before the interview, when the company announces its verdict: only one will be hired. On the day of the interview, mysterious envelopes arrive, each containing one of their secrets — and suspicion begins to take hold. Who among the six is the liar?

trailers.overview: Putri had run away from home about a year prior. When she was finally found by her mother, Mak Elli, and her younger sister, Alana, Putri was ill following childbirth; she had originally fled after becoming pregnant by her boyfriend. Mak Elli insisted that Putri and her baby, Raman, return home to reunite with the family. After moving back, however, Putri’s condition deteriorated, and she passed away. Since then, local residents have complained about sightings of Putri’s wandering spirit, which appears to be lingering as if there is unfinished business.

trailers.overview: After eight-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a brutal assault in Golden Gate Park, she begins acting out violently to protect herself. This emotional trauma leads to conflicts between her parents as they search for justice, and a way to feel safe again.

trailers.overview: Tracing her journey from the Bronx to global icon, Jennifer Lopez delivers a production that is as intimate as it is spectacular, backed by a full orchestra, vocal ensemble, and 16 dancers. The show blends her most iconic hits with personal storytelling, featuring the artists and songs that influenced her. The result is a show that feels modern, nostalgic, and timeless.
